component.name: GarageJam
component.summary: Record and mix jam sessions track by track

description.p: GarageJam is a multitrack music recording studio for the GNOME desktop. Lay down a take, then overdub new parts while listening to the ones you already have.

ul.li: Record from any microphone or audio interface through GStreamer
Overdub on top of existing tracks with live input and output meters
Per-track volume, pan, mute and solo, adjustable while playing
Import audio files and export a stereo WAV mixdown
Projects are stored in the open GarageJam XML (GJXML) format

description.p: GarageJam 8.0.1 is a rewrite of the studio in C with GTK 4, libadwaita and GStreamer.

ul.li: New multitrack recording engine with overdub
Live mixer: volume, pan, mute and solo while playing
Waveform timeline, level meters and WAV mixdown export
